title: False Discoveries: the false discovery rate in finance
channel: FIT Centre: Finance, Innovation and Technology
uploader: FIT Centre: Finance, Innovation and Technology
description:
Webinar by Dr. Marcos Lopez de Prado, in the FIT Social webinar series of the Centre of Finance, Innovation and Technology (FIT Centre). 

Marcos is a leading researcher and practitioner in quantitative finance and financial machine learning. He is Global Head of Quantitative Research and Development at the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, ADIA, and a professor at Cornell University’s College of Engineering. He is also a Research Fellow at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and a founding board member of ADIA Lab.
